question: Telecom Company Bharti Airtel has signed an agreement to buy what percentage of Vodafone's stake in Indus Towers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) 4.7**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharti Airtel** has signed an agreement to buy **4.7%** of Vodafone's stake in Indus Towers.
 
• This acquisition will strengthen Airtel's position in the telecom infrastructure sector.
 
• Indus Towers is one of the largest telecom tower companies in India, providing shared telecom infrastructure to telecom operators.
 
• The move is seen as part of Bharti Airtel's strategy to consolidate its holdings and enhance its operational capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indus Towers** was formed as a joint venture between Bharti Infratel, Vodafone India, and Aditya Birla Telecom.
 
• The company provides passive infrastructure services to all telecom operators in India.
 
• With this acquisition, Bharti Airtel aims to optimize its network and enhance service quality for its customers.
 
• The telecom sector in India is witnessing significant consolidation and strategic partnerships to improve competitiveness and service delivery.
